text:
maria: quick heads-up — putting together the Q3 slice of the Dedicated capacity roadmap. Need triage on: (1) reserve SKU bands, (2) burst credit policy (carryover vs expiry), (3) autoscale hysteresis & preemption ordering. Want to lock API/console UX by Fri.

ajay: +1. For SKU bands I want 3 clear tiers: starter (~1 GPU eq), standard (~4 GPU eq), enterprise (>16). We should attach latency SLOs and pricing gaps.

tal: product perspective — offer a small "burst add-on" that can be purchased by starter customers. Strong preference: make carryover opt-in, not default. Billing complexity if carryover is automatic.

sophia: note from customers: several enterprise pilots explicitly asked for carryover (they argued for buffering month-to-month). Legal flagged we need explicit opt-in + auditable usage history.

ben: engineering constraints to consider: preemptible tenants require ~30s drain + KV cache rehydrate cost on failover. Prewarm time for a cold pool slot is typically 90–180s depending on model size. Recommend autoscale cooldown >= 180s to avoid flapping. Example config we could start from:

```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 16
  scale_up_window: 60s
  scale_down_cooldown: 180s
  preempt_order: [enterprise, standard, starter]
```

ajay: also think we should support soft quotas (throttle + alerts) before hard rejects. Better UX and easier migration for customers.

maria: what about the burst window itself? current idea: 10-minute sliding window with a token-bucket credit model.

tal: 10m seems short for batchy or spiky enterprise jobs. Suggest tiered windows: starter=10m, standard=30m, enterprise=60m (or carryover enabled).

sophia: billing note — if we implement carryover, we need to decide credit unit: token vs time vs USD-minutes. Customers care about predictability; finance prefers USD-denominated units.

ben: implementational impact: tiered windows + carryover increases quota service complexity and testing surface. Rough estimate: +2 dev sprints to ship a robust rollout (includes migration path and telemetry).

maria: good context. Action items: Ben to draft dev effort + risk estimate by Tue EOD. Ajay to draft SKU pricing bands + target SLOs. Sophia to sync with legal/finance on opt-in and billing unit. Tal to prototype UX mock of purchase + carryover toggle. We'll review Wed 10:00. @here please add quick comments or objections.

ops-bot: meeting created — Product Dedicated Roadmap Sync Wed 10:00 in #product. Invite sent to participants.

maria: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
